1.en: And make an altar for burning incense
of acacia wood shall you make it.

2.en: Its length a cubit, and its breadth a cubit
its horns shall be from it.

3.en: And overlay it with pure gold
its top and its walls all around, and its horns

3.ja: ואצנע לה. זיגא מן ד'הב מסתדירא
3.en: and make for it a rim of gold all around.

4.ja: וחלקתין מן ד'הב. תצנעהמא לה מן דון זיגה
4.en: And two rings of gold shall you make for it below its rim
4.he: וּשְׁתֵּי טַבְּעֹת זָהָב תַּעֲשֶׂה-לּוֹ מִתַּחַת לְזֵרוֹ

4.en: on its two sides — thus on both its sides
they shall be places for the poles, by which it is carried.
4.he: וְהָיָה לְבָתִּים לְבַדִּים לָשֵׂאת אֹתוֹ בָּהֵמָּה

5.en: And make the poles of acacia wood

6.ja: ואגעלה בין ידי אלסגף. אלד'י עלי' צנדוק אלשהאדה
6.en: And set it before the curtain that is upon the ark of the testimony
6.he: וְנָתַתָּה אֹתוֹ לִפְנֵי הַפָּרֹכֶת אֲשֶׁר עַל-אֲרֹן הָעֵדֻת

6.ja: בין ידי אלג'שא. אלד'י עלי' אלשהאדה
6.en: before the cover that is upon the testimony
where I shall present Myself to you there.

7.ja: ויבכ'ר עליה הרון מן בכור אלצמוג'
7.en: And Aaron shall burn incense upon it — from the incense of resins
when he tends the lamp, he shall burn incense with it.

8.ja: וכד'אלך אד'א אסרג אלסרג. בין אלג'רובין בכ'ר בה
8.en: And likewise when he lights the lamp between the two times of sunset, he shall burn incense with it
8.he: וּבְהַעֲלֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת-הַנֵּרֹת בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם יַקְטִירֶנָּה

8.ja: ב'כורא דאימא. בין ידי אללה לאגיאלכם
8.en: a continual burning of incense before God, for your generations.

9.en: You shall not burn upon it any strange incense
nor a burnt-offering, nor a gift-offering
and a libation you shall not pour upon it.

10.ja: ויסתג'פר הרון ענד ארכאנה. מרה פי אלסנה
10.en: And Aaron shall seek atonement at its horns once a year
from the blood of the sacrifice of the Day of Atonement

10.ja: מרה פי אלסנה יסתג'פר ענדה לאגיאלכם
10.en: once a year he shall seek atonement at it for your generations
it is of the choicest of holy things, belonging to God.

11.en: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.

12.ja: אד'י חצלת גמלה' בני אסראיל עלי' עדדהם
12.en: When you have tallied the total of the sons of Israel by their number

12.ja: פליעט כל רגל פדא נפסה. ללה אד'א אחציתהם
12.en: each man shall give a ransom for himself to God when you count them
12.he: וְנָתְנוּ אִישׁ כֹּפֶר נַפְשׁוֹ לַיהוָה בִּפְקֹד אֹתָם

12.ja: ולא יחל בהם ובא ענד ד'אלך
12.en: so that no plague shall befall them at that time.

13.ja: הד'י מא יעט. כל מן גאז עליה אלעדד
13.en: This is what every one who passes through the count shall give
half a mithqal, by the mithqal of the sanctuary
half of it is a contribution to God.

14.ja: כל מן גאז עליה אלעדד. מן אבן עשרין סנה פצאעדא
14.en: Every one who passes through the count, from twenty years of age and upward
14.he: כֹּל הָעֹבֵר עַל-הַפְּקֻדִים מִבֶּן עֶשְׂרִים שָׁנָה וָמָעְלָה

14.en: shall give a contribution to God.

15.en: The well-off shall not give more
and the poor shall not give less

15.ja: פאעטו רפיעה ללה. וכפרו ען אנפסכם
15.en: so give a contribution to God, and make atonement for yourselves.

16.ja: וכ'ד' פצ'ה' אלגפראן. מן בני אסראיל
16.en: And take the silver of atonement from the sons of Israel
16.he: וְלָקַחְתָּ אֶת-כֶּסֶף הַכִּפֻּרִים מֵאֵת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל

16.en: and direct it to the service of the tent of assembly

16.ja: ויכון לבני אסראיל ד'כרא בין ידי אללה
16.en: and it shall be for the sons of Israel a remembrance before God
16.he: וְהָיָה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְזִכָּרוֹן לִפְנֵי יְהוָה

17.en: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.

18.ja: ואצנע חוץ' מן נחאס. ומקעדה מן נחאס לאלג'סל
18.en: And make a basin of copper, and its base of copper, for washing
and set it between the tent of assembly and the altar
18.he: וְנָתַתָּ אֹתוֹ בֵּין-אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וּבֵין הַמִּזְבֵּחַ

19.en: And Aaron and his sons shall wash from it

20.ja: פי דכולהם אלי' כ'בא אלמחצ'ר. יג'תסלון באלמא ולא יהלכון
20.en: Upon their entry into the tent of assembly, they shall wash with water and shall not perish
and upon their approach to the altar to draw near
and burn an offering to God

21.en: they shall wash their hands and their feet and shall not perish
And this shall be for them an ordinance forever
for him and his sons, for their generations.

22.en: Then God spoke to Moses in speech.

23.ja: ואנת פכ'ד' לך מן רוס אלאטיאב
23.en: And you — take for yourself the choicest of spices

23.ja: מן אלמסך אלכ'אלץ כ'מס מאיה' מת'קאל
23.en: of pure musk, five hundred mithqals

23.ja: ומן אלעוד אלטייב נצפה מאיתין וכ'מסין מת'קאל
23.en: and of fragrant aloeswood, half of it — two hundred and fifty mithqals
and of aromatic reed, two hundred and fifty

24.ja: ומן אלקסט. כ'מס מאיה' מת'קאל במת'קאל אלקדס
24.en: and of costus, five hundred mithqals, by the mithqal of the sanctuary
and of olive oil, a full qist.

25.en: And make of these the holy anointing oil
a perfumed blend, the craft of a perfumer
thus shall it be the holy anointing oil.

26.en: And anoint with it the tent of assembly
and the ark of the testimony

27.en: and the table and all its vessels
and the lampstand and its vessels

28.en: and the altar of burnt-offering and all its vessels
and the basin and its base.

29.en: that they may be Mine — of the choicest of holy things
whoever approaches them shall be consecrated.

30.en: And anoint Aaron and his sons
and consecrate them, that they may serve as imāms for Me.

31.en: And instruct the sons of Israel, saying

31.ja: יכון הד'א לכם. ד'הן מסח אלקדס לאגיאלכם
31.en: this shall be for you the holy anointing oil, for your generations.

32.ja: עלי' בדן איי אנסאן לא ידהן מנה
32.en: Upon the body of any person it shall not be applied
and in its composition you shall not make anything like it

32.ja: וכמא הו קדס. כד'אך קדסא יכון לכם
32.en: and as it is consecrated, so shall it be holy to you.

33.en: Any person who perfumes himself with the like of it
or puts any of it upon a stranger
shall be cut off from his people.

34.ja: מנהא עוד בלסאן ואצ'פאר טיב ומאיעה. צמוג'
34.en: among them: balsam-wood, fragrant nail-shells, and liquid storax — resins

35.en: And make of these an incense — a perfume, the craft of a perfumer
35.he: וְעָשִׂיתָ אֹתָהּ קְטֹרֶת רֹקַח מַעֲשֵׂה רוֹקֵחַ

36.en: And you shall grind some of it fine

36.ja: ואגעלה חד'א אלשהאדה פי כ'בא אלמחצ'ר
36.en: and place it beside the testimony in the tent of assembly
36.he: וְנָתַתָּה מִמֶּנָּה לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד

36.en: where I shall present Myself to you there
and it shall be for you of the choicest of holy things.

37.en: And the incense which you make
in its composition you shall not make any like it for yourselves

37.ja: קדסא יכון לכם. כמא הו ללה
37.en: it shall be holy to you, just as it is for God.

38.ja: אי אנסאן צנע מת'לה ליתבכ'ר בה
38.en: Any person who makes the like of it in order to perfume himself with it
shall be cut off from his people.
